The latest information, news and events in France, Europe and around the world.</description><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 13:30:01 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>France</category><title>Unions vow to keep pressure on French government after fourth wave of protests</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261108-unions-vow-to-keep-pressure-on-french-government-after-fourth-wave-of-protests</link><description>
Education union chiefs on Sunday vowed to maintain pressure on the government after student organisations called for another day of nationwide strikes and demonstrations on Tuesday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a57fc52e-db63-11f1-b306-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/prote.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a57fc52e-db63-11f1-b306-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/prote.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">36cb7bb6-dac6-11f1-b148-e9346ba72bac</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:00:57 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a57fc52e-db63-11f1-b306-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/prote.jpg">AP Photo/Emma Da Silva - Emma Da Silva</source><dc:creator>Paul Myers</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>French students vow to continue protests</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/video/20261107-french-students-vow-to-continue-protests-paris</link><description>
French pupils and students are protesting and blockading schools over poor conditions and a university admissions system (Parcoursup) seen as over-selective and opaque. Despite recent concessions by the government, students at Hélène Boucher high school in Paris say they'll continue, even after riot place were sent to break their blockade.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bed31678-c945-11f1-84f0-638c1c1f5fd6/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-16T075646Z-1864054812-RC274OA7GQ58-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST-2.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bed31678-c945-11f1-84f0-638c1c1f5fd6/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-16T075646Z-1864054812-RC274OA7GQ58-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST-2.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8c9b5ff0-dab9-11f1-a45a-31b57fcb4ae5</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:02:47 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France braces for second day of protests within 48 hours</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261107-france-braces-for-second-day-of-protests-within-48-hours</link><description>
Hundreds of thousands of people were expected to take to the streets on Saturday for a day of protests over the poor conditions in schools and the rising cost of living.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb2ec67e-d9cd-11f1-a5cc-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T151241Z-1266580735-RC2OHOAVSIEZ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb2ec67e-d9cd-11f1-a5cc-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T151241Z-1266580735-RC2OHOAVSIEZ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">33ad1cbc-da96-11f1-8df4-1da1eb33321e</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 12:10:04 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb2ec67e-d9cd-11f1-a5cc-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T151241Z-1266580735-RC2OHOAVSIEZ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">REUTERS - Hannah McKay</source><dc:creator>Paul Myers</dc:creator></item><item><category>Spotlight on France</category><title>Podcast: France's student protests and how they fuelled a larger social movement</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/podcasts/spotlight-on-france/20261106-podcast-france-s-student-protests-and-how-they-fuelled-a-larger-social-movement-may-68</link><description>
A look at France's high school protests and how they have fed into an ongoing social movement. What are the students protesting against? What impact has the police crackdown had? How has the government reacted? And a comparison with student movements of the past.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/884fdc42-d9cd-11f1-80bf-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-152-peach-pink.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/884fdc42-d9cd-11f1-80bf-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-152-peach-pink.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">bcd965aa-d9cd-11f1-b272-af07f9a85ea6</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 15:29:10 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Sarah Elzas</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French lawyers to sue interior minister over 'mutilation' of young protesters</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261106-french-lawyers-to-sue-interior-minister-over-mutilation-of-young-protesters</link><description>
Lawyers representing at least 18 people injured during protests in France in recent weeks say they intend to file a complaint against Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez over his alleged responsibility for police brutality.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ad744280-bea5-11f1-8056-578a4b968fd6/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-02T104258Z-1424347954-RC2XUNAITHZX-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ad744280-bea5-11f1-8056-578a4b968fd6/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-02T104258Z-1424347954-RC2XUNAITHZX-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">dba18ef0-d9e5-11f1-863b-f351e1b5079d</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:39:42 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ad744280-bea5-11f1-8056-578a4b968fd6/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-02T104258Z-1424347954-RC2XUNAITHZX-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">REUTERS - Nacho Doce</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>'AI cannot do everything': bullying experts warn against confiding in chatbots</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261106-one-quarter-of-young-bullying-victims-turning-to-ai-for-help-study-finds</link><description>
As a growing number of victims turn to artificial intelligence for help, experts warn that, while a virtual confidante can offer temporary relief, the focus must be on prevention and support.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/808c3c9c-cd36-11f1-b7ef-4dd8ac2cf3bf/w:1024/p:16x9/yamu-jay-school-bullying-9060270.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/808c3c9c-cd36-11f1-b7ef-4dd8ac2cf3bf/w:1024/p:16x9/yamu-jay-school-bullying-9060270.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">71185a8c-d797-11f1-a35f-45b5729425b2</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:35:34 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/808c3c9c-cd36-11f1-b7ef-4dd8ac2cf3bf/w:1024/p:16x9/yamu-jay-school-bullying-9060270.jpg">© pixabay / Yamu_Jay</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Latest figures show domestic violence still major problem in France</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261106-chilling-figures-show-domestic-violence-still-major-problem-in-france</link><description>
French authorities recorded 285,000 victims of domestic violence in 2025, mostly women, representing a 5 percent increase in a year. It comes as lawmakers debate a new law against sexual and gender-based violence that is due to be finalised at the beginning of 2027.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb36a16c-43a7-11f1-8f1d-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26090564561960.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb36a16c-43a7-11f1-8f1d-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26090564561960.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">77dc943a-d92e-11f1-90a5-5193511bd582</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 06:08:15 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb36a16c-43a7-11f1-8f1d-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26090564561960.jpg">© Andreea Alexandru / AP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>‘We’ll get them’: Macron’s private comments on rivals revealed in new book</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261105-we-ll-get-them-macron-s-private-comments-on-rivals-revealed-in-new-book</link><description>
Private messages exchanged between French President Emmanuel Macron and journalist Françoise Degois over two years have been published in a new book, revealing his views on political rivals, the rise of the far right and his own leadership. The president reportedly learnt of the book’s existence just three days before its release.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb95d9d2-d896-11f1-b8ef-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP22177506677032-1.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb95d9d2-d896-11f1-b8ef-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP22177506677032-1.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ed7d8d46-d8f9-11f1-8648-c35846abfa7a</guid><pubDate>Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:07:25 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb95d9d2-d896-11f1-b8ef-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP22177506677032-1.jpg">© AP - Susan Walsh </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French prosecutors investigate €100m cyberattack on Crédit Mutuel banking group</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261105-french-prosecutors-investigate-%E2%82%AC100m-cyberattack-on-cr%C3%A9dit-mutuel-banking-group</link><description>
French prosecutors have opened an investigation into a sophisticated cyberattack on Crédit Mutuel Arkéa involving fraudulent transfers estimated at around €100 million, as the Brittany-based banking group races to recover the stolen funds.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a8dda14a-d907-11f1-a6f6-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Cr%C3%A9dit-Mutuel-Ark%C3%A9a.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a8dda14a-d907-11f1-a6f6-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Cr%C3%A9dit-Mutuel-Ark%C3%A9a.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d4c86e50-d8f5-11f1-8292-031c66ea2070</guid><pubDate>Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:31:26 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a8dda14a-d907-11f1-a6f6-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Cr%C3%A9dit-Mutuel-Ark%C3%A9a.jpg">AFP - FRED TANNEAU</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>MPs unanimously reject 2027 French budget as political deadlock continues</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261105-french-mps-unanimously-reject-2027-budget-as-political-deadlock-deepens</link><description>
France's National Assembly has overwhelmingly rejected the government's draft budget for 2027 after MPs from across the political spectrum voted against a heavily amended version of the legislation, sending the bill to the Senate in its original form and setting the stage for another round of difficult negotiations.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8c795750-c2d3-11f1-9d03-c55799ef8309/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2DV9WP.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8c795750-c2d3-11f1-9d03-c55799ef8309/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2DV9WP.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">94610092-d8ec-11f1-83cc-05d8d1a87801</guid><pubDate>Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:19:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8c795750-c2d3-11f1-9d03-c55799ef8309/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D2DV9WP.jpg">© AFP/Dimitar Dilkoff</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Mass protests sweep France as workers and students demand higher pay and funding</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261105-french-unions-join-forces-for-nationwide-strike-as-protests-intensify</link><description>
Hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets across France on Thursday as workers, students and pensioners joined nationwide strikes and demonstrations demanding higher wages, action on the cost of living and better public services. Nearly 1.6 million people joined the marches, including 350,000 in Paris, the CGT union said. The Interior Ministry gave a much lower nationwide estimate of around 600,000.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/3e9309cc-d936-11f1-b338-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26309546527183.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/3e9309cc-d936-11f1-b338-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26309546527183.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d1ac4db2-d847-11f1-8e8e-b39696b484d3</guid><pubDate>Thu, 05 Nov 2026 07:11:27 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/3e9309cc-d936-11f1-b338-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26309546527183.jpg">© AP Photo/Thibault Camus</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Students blockade dozens of high schools in France before nationwide strike</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261103-students-blockade-dozens-of-high-schools-in-france-before-nationwide-strike</link><description>
Students blockaded dozens of high schools across France on Tuesday to maintain pressure on the government over education reforms as trade unions prepared for a nationwide strike later this week.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/21c9ae56-d6d2-11f1-afea-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D64N373.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/21c9ae56-d6d2-11f1-afea-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D64N373.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0f797ebc-d75d-11f1-9716-917a4357a158</guid><pubDate>Tue, 03 Nov 2026 12:20:54 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/21c9ae56-d6d2-11f1-afea-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D64N373.jpg">© Matthieu Rondel / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Calls mount to ban French TV channel following racist killing</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261102-calls-mount-to-ban-french-tv-channel-after-racist-killing</link><description>
A petition urging that a French television channel be taken off air gained traction on Monday, after accusations that far-right views it aired contributed to the racist killing of a black man. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/25b7c5b8-d6c6-11f1-947b-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4Y89JC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/25b7c5b8-d6c6-11f1-947b-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4Y89JC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8d41d30a-d6d4-11f1-996a-c9565a8083a3</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:54:59 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/25b7c5b8-d6c6-11f1-947b-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4Y89JC.jpg">AFP - SIMON WOHLFAHRT</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France braces for fresh protests as students to resume school blockades</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261102-france-braces-for-fresh-protests-as-students-to-resume-school-blockades</link><description>
France is readying for another week of protests after the head of a student group said a campaign of high school blockades would restart Monday, ahead of a nationwide day of strikes and protests on Thursday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8bf6d858-c15b-11f1-967e-b942c38e4bd7/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-06T073959Z-1661401214-RC2JXNALODN9-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8bf6d858-c15b-11f1-967e-b942c38e4bd7/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-06T073959Z-1661401214-RC2JXNALODN9-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">fe830974-d5e6-11f1-94c2-0ddebd68042b</guid><pubDate>Mon, 02 Nov 2026 07:09:12 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8bf6d858-c15b-11f1-967e-b942c38e4bd7/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-06T073959Z-1661401214-RC2JXNALODN9-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">REUTERS - Tom Nicholson</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Five British anti-immigration activists arrested in northern France</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261101-five-british-anti-migrant-ultra-right-activists-arrested-in-north-of-france</link><description>
French police say they've arrested five British far-right activists found carrying tear gas bombs, as they were filming themselves harassing migrants near the northern Channel port of Dunkirk.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/31d0c036-4bf0-11ec-abc5-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP21324042369756.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/31d0c036-4bf0-11ec-abc5-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP21324042369756.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ed941388-d5fa-11f1-9c92-8d270bd12c5c</guid><pubDate>Sun, 01 Nov 2026 14:18:30 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/31d0c036-4bf0-11ec-abc5-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/AP21324042369756.jpg">© AP Photo/Louis Witter</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France launches 'attempted murder' probe after petrol bomb attack on police</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261101-france-launches-attempted-murder-probe-after-petrol-bomb-attack-on-police</link><description>
France has launched an attempted murder investigation after petrol bombs were thrown at security forces during a weekend protest in Paris, prosecutors told AFP on Sunday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f2d8ffc4-d565-11f1-aa94-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/84b0f9d200b86233f18834393d966b98a1b52af4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f2d8ffc4-d565-11f1-aa94-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/84b0f9d200b86233f18834393d966b98a1b52af4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c8e54780-d5f7-11f1-8f9a-d78b8e884648</guid><pubDate>Sun, 01 Nov 2026 13:26:02 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f2d8ffc4-d565-11f1-aa94-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/84b0f9d200b86233f18834393d966b98a1b52af4.jpg">© Sameer AL-DOUMY / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France sees third weekend of protests as youth-led rallies sweep Europe</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261031-france-sees-third-weekend-of-protests-as-youth-led-rallies-sweep-europe</link><description>
Hundreds of thousands of mostly young protesters, some dressed as clowns and witches for Halloween, took to the streets across France on Saturday in a third weekend of demonstrations over living costs and education. Police fired tear gas in Paris after clashes broke out at the end of the march. Youth rallies were also held in Germany and Italy.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/316d67d0-d54c-11f1-a9e9-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T161057Z-1540280500-RC2FEOAN304W-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/316d67d0-d54c-11f1-a9e9-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T161057Z-1540280500-RC2FEOAN304W-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">1eff833e-d543-11f1-b06a-ffc2e7fd2caa</guid><pubDate>Sat, 31 Oct 2026 17:46:47 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/316d67d0-d54c-11f1-a9e9-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T161057Z-1540280500-RC2FEOAN304W-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">REUTERS - Manon Cruz</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Minister warns of risk of violence ahead of Halloween 'night of darkness' protests</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261031-minister-warns-of-risk-of-violence-ahead-of-halloween-night-of-darkness-protests</link><description>
With student groups and Yellow Vest activists set for a third consecutive weekend of demonstrations against poor conditions in schools and the rising cost of living, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez has said 70,000 police officers and gendarmes will be deployed across France on Saturday. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/69f81ba6-d450-11f1-b62e-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3KU3H6.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/69f81ba6-d450-11f1-b62e-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3KU3H6.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">4b9a3b5e-d445-11f1-9e6a-5f14884e5daf</guid><pubDate>Sat, 31 Oct 2026 08:34:58 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/69f81ba6-d450-11f1-b62e-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3KU3H6.jpg">AFP - CHRISTOPHE ARCHAMBAULT</source><dc:creator>Paul Myers</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>What is France's 'great replacement' conspiracy theory and how is it spreading?</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261030-what-is-france-s-great-replacement-conspiracy-theory-and-how-is-it-spreading</link><description>
A week after shootings in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière that are being investigated as a terrorist attack motivated by race, the mayor of Trappes has called for the "great replacement" theory – which claims white French people are being deliberately replaced by non-Europeans – to be banned by law.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec23f022-d44c-11f1-9a4a-8d24f1bca529</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 17:47:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg">AP - Laurent Cipriani</source><dc:creator>Alison Hird</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French dockworkers strike over budget measures and militarisation of ports</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261030-french-dockworkers-strike-over-budget-measures-and-militarisation-of-ports-arms-war</link><description>
French ports are expected to be almost completely shut down on Friday as dockworkers join a 24-hour strike across 22 countries to protest against the use of ports for arms exports. French workers are also demonstrating against proposed measures in the country's draft budget. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e5d1f3dc-d432-11f1-82fd-876b12b9de9a</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:19:09 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg">AFP - ROBERT FRANCOIS</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Paris suburb shooting suspect 'targeted Muslims, Africans or North Africans'</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261029-paris-suburb-shooting-suspect-targeted-muslims-africans-or-north-africans</link><description>
The man being held over the shootings which took place last Friday in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière – which left one man dead and several people wounded, including an 11-year-old girl – has said he specifically targeted people of Muslim, African or North African appearance, anti-terrorism investigators revealed on Thursday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">59bc4dbe-d38f-11f1-83b1-93c98f0401df</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:46:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg">© Simon Wohlfahrt / AFP</source><dc:creator>Paul Myers</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>US judge narrows Macrons' defamation lawsuit against American podcaster</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261029-us-judge-narrows-macrons-defamation-lawsuit-against-american-podcaster</link><description>
A judge in the United States has ruled that French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte ​could continue their defamation lawsuit against the companies of the American podcaster Candace Owens, but not against Owens herself.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f69de15a-d2e6-11f1-b28c-a7bbbeea0b20/w:1024/p:16x9/macrons-1.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f69de15a-d2e6-11f1-b28c-a7bbbeea0b20/w:1024/p:16x9/macrons-1.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">6fe1d764-d2e3-11f1-a43e-e1cb8b9ae305</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:59:59 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f69de15a-d2e6-11f1-b28c-a7bbbeea0b20/w:1024/p:16x9/macrons-1.jpg">© REUTERS - Abdul Saboor </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French Senate toughens proposals to make rioters pay for damage</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261028-french-senate-toughens-proposals-to-make-rioters-pay-for-damage</link><description>
The upper house of the French parliament has toughened a proposed law that would make people who participate in rioting and vandalism liable for up to €10,000, after nationwide protests against failing schools and the cost of living that turned violent in Paris and other cities. Rights groups warn the legislation could undermine the democratic right to protest.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c71b5e2c-d2ae-11f1-aba7-f34b6a3fdc30</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:09:11 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">© REUTERS - Manon Cruz </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French media protest manhandling of journalists at far-right party rally</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261028-french-media-protest-manhandling-of-journalists-at-far-right-party-rally</link><description>
More than 40 French media groups, including Radio France International, have called on Marine Le Pen's far-right National Rally (RN) to allow them to work freely after journalists were allegedly subjected to rough treatment at a party congress last weekend.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/070e7ae4-d103-11f1-b093-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26298582746791.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/070e7ae4-d103-11f1-b093-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26298582746791.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">dbf22298-d215-11f1-aed5-c12f4bfedcff</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 07:07:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/070e7ae4-d103-11f1-b093-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26298582746791.jpg">© AP Photo/Teresa Suarez</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French breast cancer patients challenge the Pink October 'party'</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261027-breast-cancer-patients-challenge-the-glitter-of-france-s-pink-october</link><description>
Patients in France are increasingly rejecting the "glitter" of the annual breast cancer awareness campaign of Pink October. They say celebrations and cosmetic tie-ins can feel far removed from the reality of treatment and act as a smokescreen for political inaction and the dangers of environmental and workplace exposure to carcinogens. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f610270e-1536-11ea-a0d9-005056a99247/w:1024/p:16x9/7-TOUR%20EIFFEL%20ROSE_PRW_IMG_5392_0.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f610270e-1536-11ea-a0d9-005056a99247/w:1024/p:16x9/7-TOUR%20EIFFEL%20ROSE_PRW_IMG_5392_0.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">65204b70-cec0-11f1-ad11-274d6bd9302f</guid><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:36:22 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/f610270e-1536-11ea-a0d9-005056a99247/w:1024/p:16x9/7-TOUR%20EIFFEL%20ROSE_PRW_IMG_5392_0.jpg">RFI/Pierre René-Worms</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

      <title>Russo on target again as double fires under-pressure Arsenal to vital WSL win at Liverpool</title>

      <description><p>Alessia Russo scored twice at Anfield to provide the under-pressure Arsenal head coach, Renée Slegers, with some brief respite but it was another unconvincing display from the north Londoners despite their much-needed 2-1 victory.</p><p>The in-form Russo’s double took her recent tally to seven goals in her past four appearances and 10 in her past seven games for club and country, but Liverpool posed plenty of problems for the visitors and were unhappy about a disallowed goal.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/liverpool-arsenal-wsl-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Julián Alvarez’s Atlético redemption arc in full focus for visit of Barcelona</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/julian-alvarezs-atletico-redemption-arc-in-full-focus-for-visit-of-barcelona</link>
      <description><p>Top spot is up for grabs in Sunday’s heavyweight clash as the Spider faces the team that tried to trap him last summer</p><p>Julián Alvarez said sorry but forgiveness must be earned on the field and Sunday would be the perfect place. At 9pm at the Metropolitano, Atlético Madrid play Barcelona. It is the biggest match in Spain right now, a place at the top of the table awaiting the winner; it is also the game the striker they call <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/article/2024/aug/26/mbappe-and-alvarez-bring-superhero-factor-but-sidekicks-pack-a-punch">the Spider</a> planned to play on the other side. That, Alvarez said in Dallas, was his “dream”. Denied that, he must defeat the men he wanted to join to win back the supporters he wanted to walk out on, no better opportunity than now.</p><p>He has beaten them before. Last season, Atlético knocked Barcelona out of the Copa del Rey <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/apr/14/atletico-madrid-barcelona-champions-league-match-report">and Champions League</a>. Alvarez scored both times but beneath the surface something had shifted in him and by the time the World Cup came round he admitted his desire to leave for Catalonia. That day, after Argentina beat Algeria, he didn’t name Barcelona and he didn’t need to; everyone knew. “It’s not the time to talk about this but nor can I hide,” he said. “I spoke with the people I needed to and the best thing for everyone is a transfer.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/julian-alvarezs-atletico-redemption-arc-in-full-focus-for-visit-of-barcelona">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Enzo Maresca rues Manchester City’s lack of desire after defeat at Nottingham Forest</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/enzo-maresca-nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>‘You need desire and intensity … we didn’t match them’</p></li><li><p>City have now lost three successive league matches</p></li></ul><p>Enzo Maresca blamed his side’s lack of desire and the way they were outgunned in duels for a third successive Premier League defeat. After winning their first seven games of the season, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league-match-report">Manchester City’s 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest</a> extended their poor run.</p><p>Jair Cunha dispossessed Josko Gvardiol to score the opener, then Liam Delap struck twice with muscular surges on the break as Forest won their first home league game since April. “Today I think [the problem] has been general,” said Maresca. “It’s not about one player. In the first half we lost all the duels, all the contacts. Against this team, that is fighting relegation, if you don’t match them … it’s something we need to understand. In this kind of game, if you’re not able to win duels and second balls like in the first half, you struggle.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/enzo-maresca-nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/arsenal-hull-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p>As most Arsenal supporters would testify, patience is a virtue. They needed plenty during the 22-year wait <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/may/19/arsenal-premier-league-champions-manchester-city-bournemouth">to be crowned Premier League champions</a> and Mikel Arteta’s side certainly had to retain their composure as they tried to break down a dogged Hull side. They had not beaten Arsenal in 14 attempts since winning on their first visit to this ground in 2008. But with 20 minutes to play, there was still every chance that Sergej Jakirovic’s team could have pulled off one of the shocks of the season.</p><p>Arsenal had already been denied a penalty just before half-time for a shirt pull on Kai Havertz in the box a week after escaping <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/01/liverpool-arsenal-premier-league-match-report">the same crime against Liverpool</a> at Anfield, in a moment of controversy that could have been the major talking point from this match. Martin Ødegaard had other ideas and the Arsenal captain’s fifth goal of the season was enough to ensure they will go into the international break with a healthy lead over Manchester City. Enzo Maresca’s side are up next here in the league after the international break, with Arsenal having matched their record tally of 27 points from their opening 10 games. The signs look ominous for the rest, even if they were made to work for the points throughout by their opponents.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/arsenal-hull-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Rise of the ‘schooligans’: how a wave of antisocial behaviour threatens non-league football</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/antisocial-behaviour-non-league-football-youth-hooligans-police</link>
      <description><p>Teenage ultras are increasingly causing disorder and communities fear it will not be long before it becomes something more dangerous</p><p>It is five past three on Saturday afternoon and the teenage ultras of Hednesford Town are running late. They have arrived in Chester for their team’s National League North fixture and have hailed taxis, determined to make their presence felt at the ground. But word appears to have got out about their arrival. As one car turns away from the city’s charming half-timbered houses and into narrow residential streets, half a dozen local youths appear, haring round the corner in balaclavas. They try to attack the cab and chase after it as it pulls away. The smell of pyro is everywhere. As the taxi finally gets clear, the Chester gang stops in the middle of the road, shouting and gesticulating. One lad, no older than 16, pulls a long blade from inside his trousers and brandishes it.</p><p>The incident ended there and no one was hurt, though a police investigation has been launched. The match went off without trouble too and the Hednesford gang – known at home as the “schooligans” – were escorted safely back to the station by Cheshire police. It was just another weekend in English non-league football, where a wave of antisocial behaviour is causing concern and leading the UK Football Policing Unit (UKFPU) to declare it its “most important” priority. As the disorder continues, a question remains: how long will it be before teenage trouble-making becomes something more dangerous?</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/antisocial-behaviour-non-league-football-youth-hooligans-police">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>‘A footballing alien’: Mamadou Sangaré soars to Premier League heights</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/a-footballing-alien-mamadou-sangare-brentford-mali-premier-league</link>
      <description><p>Brentford’s Mali midfielder stood out when he was six and has shone in the Premier League since £39m transfer</p><p>“When I first saw him, I thought to myself: ‘Who on earth is this player?’ laughs Youness Bengelloun as he remembers Mamadou Sangaré. With the transfer window in full swing in July 2025, the former Manchester City scout and agent was not expecting to come face to face with a “footballing alien”, but that proved the case during a visit to Rapid Vienna’s training ground. A few weeks later, Sangaré moved to Lens for around €5m. “He was impressive and what struck me was his technique and his work rate,” Bengelloun says.</p><p>That’s more or less the impression Sangaré has made at every club he’s played for, including Brentford, for whom the Mali midfielder signed, from Lens, for a club-record £39m at the start of August. The 24-year-old excelled in his debut <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/22/brentford-tottenham-premier-league-match-report">against Tottenham a few weeks later</a>, dominating the centre of the pitch and providing the assist for Keane Lewis-Potter’s opening goal, and has featured in every game this season, with Brighton up next. “I gave him his debut for Mali in September 2024, against Mozambique. He made an immediate impact,” says Sangaré’s former international manager Tom Saintfiet. “He’s every manager’s dream player.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/a-footballing-alien-mamadou-sangare-brentford-mali-premier-league">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Bellinghams celebrate ‘beautiful story’ as Jobe joins Jude in Tuchel’s England 2.0</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/06/jude-jobe-bellingham-thomas-tuchel-england-croatia-spain-nations-league</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Jude had asked head coach to scout Dortmund midfielder</p></li><li><p>‘It will be beautiful for Jude to have his brother close’</p></li></ul><p>Thomas Tuchel has given a <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/06/jobe-bellingham-england-squad-brother-jude-josh-king-ben-white">first England call-up to Jobe Bellingham</a>, admitting the midfielder’s older brother, Jude, had nagged him to do so, as he set up the prospect of their family dream being realised.</p><p>Tuchel’s inclusion of the younger Bellingham for the Nations League games against Croatia and Spain was further evidence of his shift away from the squad that served him well at the World Cup last summer and towards a fresh dynamic for the mission to win Euro 2028. La Pologne en deuil s'est réveillée choquée dimanche, au lendemain de la tuerie perpétrée à Cracovie par un jeune "fasciné" par les idées d'extrême droite, qui a abattu six personnes et en a blessé quinze.

Les célébrations de Diwali ont débuté dimanche. À Ayodhya, considérée comme le lieu de naissance du seigneur Rama – la divinité vénérée lors de cette fête –, les célébrations comprenaient des spectacles inspirés de l’épopée hindoue « Ramayana », des spectacles de lumières et de lasers, des concerts, des feux d’artifice et des démonstrations de drones.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/69a0222a-db71-11f1-9629-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-06T152829Z-1343669324-RC2DIOA69HZH-RTRMADP-3-RELIGION-DIWALI.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/69a0222a-db71-11f1-9629-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-06T152829Z-1343669324-RC2DIOA69HZH-RTRMADP-3-RELIGION-DIWALI.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3ad6d970-db71-11f1-88bc-151ae01bc3bc</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:45:53 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Afrique</category><title>Au large du Sénégal, au moins 21 personnes sont mortes dans le naufrage d'une pirogue de migrants</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/afrique/20261108-au-large-du-s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-au-moins-21-personnes-sont-mortes-dans-le-naufrage-d-une-pirogue-de-migrants</link><description>
Au moins 21 personnes ont péri dans le naufrage d'une pirogue de migrants au large de Kébémer, dans le nord-ouest du Sénégal, ont annoncé dimanche les autorités. Selon le ministère de l'Intérieur, un seul rescapé a été retrouvé et les recherches se poursuivent pour retrouver d'éventuels survivants.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8db004c0-db6f-11f1-9c7c-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/c9e8d80cbfc13f8f43d3833c67fbf17f6e5ccb25.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8db004c0-db6f-11f1-9c7c-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/c9e8d80cbfc13f8f43d3833c67fbf17f6e5ccb25.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8e8f26e6-db6f-11f1-b40d-57a395b2cfb9</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:26:00 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8db004c0-db6f-11f1-9c7c-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/c9e8d80cbfc13f8f43d3833c67fbf17f6e5ccb25.jpg">© Patrick Meinhardt, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Trump veut Dana White, patron de la fédération de MMA, comme porte-parole</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261108-trump-veut-dana-white-patron-de-la-f%C3%A9d%C3%A9ration-de-mma-comme-porte-parole</link><description>
Donald Trump a annoncé samedi avoir proposé le poste de porte-parole de la Maison Blanche à Dana White, un de ses proches qui dirige l'UFC, principale organisation mondiale d'arts martiaux mixtes (MMA).
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6b735158-db67-11f1-9693-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-07T185814Z-773770422-RC2MSMA1HHQJ-RTRMADP-3-USA-TRUMP-PRESS-SECRETARY.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6b735158-db67-11f1-9693-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-07T185814Z-773770422-RC2MSMA1HHQJ-RTRMADP-3-USA-TRUMP-PRESS-SECRETARY.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">98a18c2e-db64-11f1-993a-a350fbfcdb9f</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:30:40 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>"Non au data-center de Rantigny" : manifestation contre le développement de l'IA</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261108-non-au-data-center-de-rantigny-manifestation-contre-le-d%C3%A9veloppement-de-l-ia</link><description>
Une manifestation a été organisée pour dire non au futur projet de data center à Rantigny (Oise), ce samedi 7 novembre 2026, réunissant riverains et élus d’opposition. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/87960ca4-db62-11f1-a08a-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-7ab7b7be.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/87960ca4-db62-11f1-a08a-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-7ab7b7be.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3e10455c-db5f-11f1-8708-01d23b3dfaeb</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:55:31 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Culture</category><title>Budget pharaonique, révolution graphique... Cinq raisons qui font de "GTA VI" le jeu du siècle</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/culture/20261108-budget-pharaonique-r%C3%A9volution-graphique-pourquoi-gta-vi-peut-devenir-jeu-si%C3%A8cle-jeux-vid%C3%A9o-rockstar</link><description>
"Grand Theft Auto VI" débarque le 19 novembre sur Playstation et Xbox Series. Qualifié de "jeu du siècle", le nouvel opus du studio Rockstar occupe une place à part dans l'industrie vidéoludique, promettant d’être l'un des objets culturels les plus influents de ces dernières années. Des cortèges parfois dispersés par les forces de l’ordre à l’aide de gaz lacrymogène.Un gaz qui provoque, pendant quelques minutes, des sensations de brûlures autour yeux et des irritations des voies respiratoires et de la peau.Mais depuis le début de la mobilisation lycéenne, manifestants et politiques se questionnent sur les conséquences des lacrymos sur notre santé.Décryptage avec Julia Rougié
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2ab2c91c-da8d-11f1-bbc9-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Miniature-lacrym-3.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2ab2c91c-da8d-11f1-bbc9-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Miniature-lacrym-3.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">25c18e30-da8c-11f1-b6da-470ca7165505</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:18:08 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Mobilisation du 7 novembre : entre 146 000 et 250 000 manifestants, des Gilets jaunes verbalisés</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261107-en-direct-nouvelle-journ%C3%A9e-de-mobilisation-en-france-pour-faire-pression-sur-le-gouvernement</link><description>
Les manifestations pour la jeunesse et contre la vie chère ont rassemblé entre 146 000 personnes, selon le ministère de l'Intérieur, et 250 000, selon l'intersyndicale de la jeunesse. La journée a été marquée par des verbalisations place de la Concorde à Paris, où des Gilets jaunes s'étaient rassemblés malgré une interdiction, et l'interpellation de deux figures du mouvement. Retrouvez le fil du 7 novembre 2026.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/04ddde06-dabb-11f1-920a-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QY8AY.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/04ddde06-dabb-11f1-920a-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QY8AY.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">36dd7254-da70-11f1-8a7b-4582f390b448</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 06:05:34 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/04ddde06-dabb-11f1-920a-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QY8AY.jpg">© Philippe Lopez, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Depuis le 17 octobre, drones et hélicoptères sont de sortie pour surveiller les manifestations</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261107-depuis-17-octobre-drones-h%C3%A9licopt%C3%A8res-sont-sortie-pour-surveiller-manifestations</link><description>
Depuis la manifestation du 17 octobre et les scènes de chaos qui l’ont accompagnée, les forces de l’ordre recourent massivement aux drones et aux hélicoptères pour scruter les mouvements de foule depuis les airs. France 24 fait le point sur les règles qui encadrent l’usage de ces appareils de surveillance et les inquiétudes des défenseurs des libertés publiques.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20ce6c3a-da24-11f1-bdce-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/000-33X34UG.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20ce6c3a-da24-11f1-bdce-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/000-33X34UG.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c4a303ea-da22-11f1-af7c-973cd9f313fd</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 05:32:56 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20ce6c3a-da24-11f1-bdce-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/000-33X34UG.jpg">AFP - JOEL SAGET</source><dc:creator>Matei DANES</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Manifestations en France : la mobilisation recule, nouvel appel à la grève mardi dans l'éducation</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261106-manifestations-en-france-la-mobilisation-recule-nouvel-appel-%C3%A0-la-gr%C3%A8ve-mardi-dans-l-%C3%A9ducation</link><description>
Entre 146 000 et 250 000 personnes ont manifesté samedi en France, contre 500 000 dans tout le pays une semaine plus tôt, pour maintenir la pression sur le gouvernement, avant une série de rendez-vous avec l'exécutif lundi. Une intersyndicale rassemblant organisations lycéennes, étudiantes et d'enseignants appelle à une nouvelle journée de grève et de manifestations mardi.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b457d050-dabe-11f1-b17a-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/4ac3ae9aea986043c2759cc7ddb89fe934bc2c31.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b457d050-dabe-11f1-b17a-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/4ac3ae9aea986043c2759cc7ddb89fe934bc2c31.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8cc68718-da3a-11f1-8ff2-5f35d8af6978</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 23:34:02 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b457d050-dabe-11f1-b17a-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/4ac3ae9aea986043c2759cc7ddb89fe934bc2c31.jpg">© Guillaume Saligot, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>"Il faut démanteler les citadelles de ce système pourri", lance Jean-Luc Mélenchon au Bourget</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261106-grand-meeting-de-m%C3%A9lenchon-au-bourget-apr%C3%A8s-la-sortie-de-son-programme-pr%C3%A9sidentiel</link><description>
Lors d'un grand meeting organisé samedi au Bourget pour présenter son programme, le leader de La France insoumise, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a appelé à "démanteler toutes les citadelles de ce système pourri". À six mois de l'élection présidentielle, le candidat LFI est donné par de nombreux sondages en mesure de se qualifier pour le second tour du scrutin.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9d39473c-dac3-11f1-81fe-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6R93X3.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9d39473c-dac3-11f1-81fe-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6R93X3.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">444db682-da3a-11f1-9b35-bd068c9a0fa1</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 23:32:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9d39473c-dac3-11f1-81fe-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6R93X3.jpg">© Kenzo Tribouillard, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Pouvoir d'achat dégradé des Français, travailler et s'appauvrir ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261106-pouvoir-d-achat-des-fran%C3%A7ais-travailler-et-s-appauvrir</link><description>
Selon un récent sondage, 85 % des Français interrogés estiment que leur pouvoir d’achat s’est dégradé en dix ans. Sont-ils effectivement en train de travailler pour vivre moins bien qu'avant ? Nous avons posé la question à l'économiste Philippe Trainar.

Clary, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Éco/Tech</category><title>Les Californiens pas séduits par la taxe sur les milliardaires</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9co-tech/20261104-les-californiens-pas-seduits-par-la-taxe-sur-les-milliardaires-proposition-40-zucman</link><description>
La proposition visant à soumettre les milliardaires à un impôt sur la fortune exceptionnel de 5 % est en passe d'être rejetée par les Californiens mercredi. C'est la première fois qu'une telle mesure était soumise à un vote aux États-Unis. Le réal brésilien a lui aussi plongé et perdu jusqu'à 10 % de sa valeur face au dollar, à un plus bas depuis décembre 2025. Le programme économique de l'ancien syndicaliste prévoit toujours plus d'investissements dans l'industrie brésilienne et pour les ménages les plus modestes, alors que la dette explose, à 82,5 % du PIB.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3fc45b04-d187-11f1-a9b3-5b4a75578ebb/w:1024/p:16x9/XX-NW-HDL-LULA-VICTORY-22H-AN-Meiqi-transfer.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3fc45b04-d187-11f1-a9b3-5b4a75578ebb/w:1024/p:16x9/XX-NW-HDL-LULA-VICTORY-22H-AN-Meiqi-transfer.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">36300328-d186-11f1-95a8-1bd8fcb5712c</guid><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 21:56:56 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laure MANENT</dc:creator></item><item><category>Éco/Tech</category><title>Polar Train LNG : pourquoi la Russie a financé "en secret" un projet gazier made in USA</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9co-tech/20261026-polar-train-lng-pourquoi-russie-a-financ%C3%A9-secret-projet-gazier-made-in-usa-etats-unis</link><description>
Novatek, l’un des principaux groupes gaziers russes, a financé en secret le développement de Polar Train LNG, un projet américain d'exploitation du gaz en Alaska, a révélé le New York Times. De quoi renforcer la main de Vladimir Poutine dans ses négociations avec Donald Trump?
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e2736f70-d155-11f1-9954-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/Novatek.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e2736f70-d155-11f1-9954-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/Novatek.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">597b60b0-d155-11f1-b539-0f48f32af499</guid><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 18:31:05 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e2736f70-d155-11f1-9954-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/Novatek.jpg">© Olesya Kurpyayeva, AFP</source><dc:creator>Sébastian SEIBT</dc:creator></item><item><category>La semaine de l’éco</category><title>Violences du 17 octobre : qui va payer l'addition ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/la-semaine-de-l-%C3%A9co/20261023-violences-du-17-octobre-qui-va-payer-l-addition</link><description>
Après les violences du 17 octobre, près de 3 000 commerces ont été dégradés selon le gouvernement. L’agence Morningstar estime le coût des dégradations à 1,2 milliard d’euros. À Paris, les professionnels du tourisme constatent une hausse des annulations. Le secteur s’inquiète, un phénomène qui pourrait s’accentuer si les débordements se poursuivent. Alors, qui va payer l’addition ? Faiza Younsi en discute avec Pierre Talamon, Philippe Crevel, Laurent Frajerman et Olivier Moustacakis.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4050dcba-cf01-11f1-9c66-5b4a75578ebb/w:1024/p:16x9/SEMAINE-ECO-23-10-2026-16-59-ING26-CLEAN-A.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4050dcba-cf01-11f1-9c66-5b4a75578ebb/w:1024/p:16x9/SEMAINE-ECO-23-10-2026-16-59-ING26-CLEAN-A.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3fbc2aa6-cf02-11f1-9452-db75628f2657</guid><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 17:19:48 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Faiza YOUNSI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Tech 24</category><title>Torturer ChatGPT, quelle drôle d’idée !</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/tech-24/20261023-torturer-chatgpt-quelle-dr%C3%B4le-d-id%C3%A9e</link><description>
Torturer une intelligence artificielle ? Elon Musk estime que c'est une très mauvaise idée. Non seulement parce qu'elle pourrait souffrir, mais parce qu'un jour, elle pourrait vouloir se venger. Et ce n'est pas de la science-fiction : le 8 octobre, Anthropic a annoncé qu'elle allait interdire de maltraiter gratuitement son assistant Claude. Au même moment, le programmeur "terrafying" a imaginé une “chambre de torture” pour IA. À quelles fins ? 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1e2ff572-cee7-11f1-aa3c-4d317af013fd/w:1024/p:16x9/Tech24-3.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1e2ff572-cee7-11f1-aa3c-4d317af013fd/w:1024/p:16x9/Tech24-3.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9bd0d30e-cec7-11f1-8138-11d5b26ff194</guid><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 13:51:47 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Guillaume GRALLET</dc:creator></item><item><category>Éco/Tech</category><title>Manifestations en France : Bitchat, la messagerie sans réseau qui a le vent en poupe</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9co-tech/20261022-manifestations-france-bitchat-messagerie-sans-r%C3%A9seau-vent-poupe</link><description>
En pleine mobilisation lycéenne et pour le pouvoir d'achat en France, Bitchat mesh se classait n°1, jeudi, des applications sur l'App Store dans la catégorie "réseaux sociaux". Lancée en juillet 2025 par le cofondateur de Twitter, cette messagerie décentralisée fonctionne avec le Bluetooth et sans Internet. Pratique quand le réseau est saturé, comme cela peut arriver dans une manifestation.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45638bf4-ce47-11f1-b62c-8d87bc3aeb3a/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3L43WH.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45638bf4-ce47-11f1-b62c-8d87bc3aeb3a/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3L43WH.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b573d26e-ce38-11f1-a23a-7d1181354bee</guid><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 18:58:11 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45638bf4-ce47-11f1-b62c-8d87bc3aeb3a/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3L43WH.jpg">© Valery Hache, AFP</source><dc:creator>Jean-Luc MOUNIER</dc:creator></item><item><category>Éco/Tech</category><title>Faille sur Internet : qu’est-ce que le PHP, qui fait tourner la majorité des sites web ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9co-tech/20261022-faille-sur-internet-qu-est-ce-que-le-php-qui-fait-tourner-la-majorit%C3%A9-des-sites-web</link><description>
